messages:
olivia: Heads-up: vendor portal rejected PO 9102 from CloudBridge. Error: VALIDATION(ENTITY_MISMATCH) + NOTE: 'signatory mismatch'. Link: https://portal.marketplace.example/po/9102
marketplace-bot: PO 9102 rejected: ENTITY_MISMATCH (signatory vs registered org). See https://docs.marketplace/dev/po-errors#entity-mismatch
raj: We have a signed order but partner used a local subsidiary for signature; finance verifies billing must be parent entity EIN. Can legal escalate a quick reissue?
marta: Partner legal says they can re-sign with parent entity but their procurement windows are strict (EOW). Willing to re-sign today if we send an updated counterparty page. Kev, can you create a corrected PO PDF and re-upload?
kev: Yep. I can generate PO9102_updated.pdf and call the API. Two questions: 1) do we split the bundle SKUs (portal sometimes complains), 2) should we include a cover note attesting parent EIN to avoid export flags?
olivia: Include the cover note from our side: "Redwood confirms billing entity is Redwood Inc (EIN: 12-3456789) per MSA." That should help. For SKUs, partner prefers not to split. If portal still blocks on bundle, we'll fall back to ops manual ingest.
raj: Also, partner's PO referenced a restricted accelerator SKU (ACC-42-EX). Procurement flagged export_control. I've asked partner to provide an ECCN declaration. If they can't, we need to remove ACC-42-EX and make a supplemental PO for compliance review.
marta: I'll chase partner legal for ECCN now. If they confirm classification within 4 hours, Kev proceed with re-upload using parent entity signer and cover note. If not, prepare split PO template without ACC-42-EX.
kev: Upload curl snippet for ops:
```
curl -X POST "https://portal.marketplace.example/api/v1/po/upload" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -F "file=@PO9102_updated.pdf" \\
  -F "metadata={\"manual_note\":\"Parent-EIN-attached\"}"
```
olivia: Thanks. Marking this as deal-desk:high. I'll pause launch comms until we have either re-signed PO + ECCN or the split-PO queued.
marta: Partner just replied: legal confirmed they can re-sign with parent entity and will send ECCN for ACC-42-EX within 2h. Sending Docusign now.
raj: Great. If Docusign completes, Kev, go ahead and upload. If portal still rejects, we'll escalate to ops manual ingest and cc finance for fee approval.
kev: Noted. I'll stand by for the signed doc.
